name: Sexy Knight
source:
A Sexy Knight type monster girl. [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] finds her hiding in the dark. Although she's a very strong warrior she's incredibly embarrassed about her skimpy clothing. Unfortunately because she's a Sexy Knight she can't do anything about her clothing.

She loves being an ally of justice but has very odd ideas about how an ally of justice is supposed to behave.
